subject.title: improve(mattermost): restart only the changed account on config reload

question: Should `reload.accountScopedRestart` become a supported channel-plugin contract, with Mattermost as its first opt-in implementation?
rationale: The patch is technically well-supported, but selecting the permanent plugin API and the isolation guarantee external plugins may rely on requires maintainer ownership rather than automated review judgment.

options.title: Approve the generic contract
options.body: Document the safety and fallback requirements, add focused public-contract coverage, refresh onto main, and land the Mattermost opt-in.

options.title: Defer account-scoped reloads
options.body: Keep whole-channel reload behavior until maintainers sponsor a different lifecycle capability or can define a narrower permanent contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic contract
recommendation.body: Document the safety and fallback requirements, add focused public-contract coverage, refresh onto main, and land the Mattermost opt-in.

likelyOwner.reason: The most relevant available history connects this contributor to the suppression and channel-reload lifecycle that constrains the new contract.
